about.lead: A full-stack developer from IPB University who likes building products from scratch, from the database to the animation details.
about.bio1: My biggest experience comes from building systems for the Indonesian Society of Respirology (PDPI), from the organization website to a nationwide member directory.
about.bio2: I am used to owning projects from planning to release: writing requirements, designing the database, building the interface, then testing it.
about.bio3: Outside code, I model in Blender. That is why I want to bring 3D depth to the web without giving up speed.
